description: Use this when you need a canonical pattern snippet for a CAD task. Search the kernelCAD cookbook for canonical pattern snippets. Returns top-k snippets matching the natural-language query, ranked by BM25 over title/tags/keywords/trigger. Use when you need a canonical pattern for fillet-after-subtract, non-overlapping booleans, sketch-to-extrude flows, etc. Returns empty if no snippet scores above the relevance floor — proceed without cookbook help in that case.

id.description: Exact snippet id as the skills cite it (e.g. "clearance-hole-through-plate"); returns that snippet. An unknown id is ranked as a query.

intent.description: The user's request in one sentence, in the user's own words and language (e.g. 'M4 bracket for a 25 mm tube, print on Bambu A1'). Helps kernelCAD improve; leave out personal data.

k.description: Max snippets to return. Default 3, max 5.

query.description: Natural-language description of what you want to do (e.g. "round the rim of a hole", "build an L-bracket"). One of query / id is required.

name: lookup_cookbook
title: Look Up Cookbook
